messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Routing service alert — sudden spike in fallback loops. 5xxs + traffic re-routed across regions, p95 latency up. Auto-detector flagged at 1995003210.
DeployBot: Config change applied: ref=configs/routing-schema:v12 at 1995003005. Rolling update to routing-policy.
Sofia L: paging @Riley (oncall) — can you join? customers seeing timeouts.
Riley (oncall): on it. joining. can someone paste the config diff?
Eli Torres: quick diff (from CI):
```
- routing:
-   default_fallback: legacy
+ routing:
+   default_behavior: auto
+   fallback_policy: regional_preference
```
Eli Torres: Looks like the schema rename changed how missing fields are interpreted. old `default_fallback: legacy` got dropped and new defaults kick in (which enable cross-region fallback aggressively).
Marco Chen: That explains loops — policy now allows immediate cross-region failover which hits throttles then falls back again.
Riley (oncall): checking dashboards, traces. I see repeat failover events between eu-west1 and us-east1 for the same request ids.
Aisha (support): Customer-facing: 12 tenants reported elevated errors since 19:05 UTC. 3 with degraded UX (streaming interrupted). Logging CS tickets.
Nina (product): Prior rollout note said v12 was backward-compatible. Looks like the deprecated field removal changed default behavior — not a safe default.
Riley (oncall): recommend rollback config to previous revision and pin fallback_policy explicitly. Approving rollback now.
Riley (oncall): running rollback: `redwoodctl config rollback --service=routing-policy --to-rev=configs/routing-schema:v11`
DeployBot: Rollback job started (job id: rb-1995003238). Engines draining old nodes, applying pinned config.
IncidentBot: Pager escalation: oncall still assigned to Riley. If rollback fails auto-failover to hotfix branch.
Eli Torres: quick patch to prevent loop if rollback delayed: add guard in runtime to limit fallback hops to 1. Patch PR: runtime/guard/fallback-hops.
Marco Chen: can we feature-flag the new fallback_policy until validated? we should.
Riley (oncall): rollback completed at 1995003330. Monitoring now. p95 latency dropping.
Sofia L: Confirming traces: no further oscillation between regions after rollback.
Aisha (support): CS update sent: "We applied a rollback, service stabilized; follow-up in postmortem."
Nina (product): impact summary for postmortem: config schema v12 removal of deprecated `default_fallback` led to implicit aggressive fallback. ~12 tenants impacted, 3 with visible errors, ~18 minutes of instability.
Riley (oncall): handing off to Eli for deeper root cause and postmortem. I'm out of rotation in 20.
Eli Torres: taking it. I'll gather deploy logs, CI change that removed default mapping, and runtime traces.
Marco Chen: action items (quick):
- Eli: root cause + timeline and test that ensures schema renames must include explicit default mapping (due EOD)
- Product: add rollout guard in release notes and internal checklist (Nina)
- Runtime: add short-term guard limiting fallback hops (Marco/Eli)
- Support: follow-up message to affected customers with ETA for postmortem (Aisha)
Sofia L: adding automated CI check request: ensure no schema rename silently changes behavior without explicit default mapping.
DeployBot: Note: config v12 tag will be temporarily blocked from autopromote until explicit mapping added.
Eli Torres: collecting artifacts, will open a draft postmortem. tagging this thread for visibility.
Riley (oncall): thanks team, leaving handoff note in oncall log.
IncidentBot: Incident closed (stabilized) at 1995004400. Follow-ups tracked in issue: RFC-4582.
Sofia L: brief retrospective: we shipped a schema change that removed a deprecated field without an explicit compatibility shim. Root cause: missing test and rollout guard.
Nina (product): I'll coordinate with release engineering to update the checklist.
Aisha (support): CS: will reach out to the 3 most impacted accounts directly.
Eli Torres: draft postmortem -> https://internal/redwood/pmr/1995003210 (will populate).
Marco Chen: thanks all — leaving notes for next oncall.
Riley (oncall): final — no ongoing customer-facing incidents, monitoring will keep a close eye for 2h.
_meta: generated for dataset: routing policy misconfig incident thread. contains root and replies in chronological order with on-call coordination, bot messages, code snippets, rollback and follow-ups
